The '''[[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]]''' was an associate of the space [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Rav]]. In [[137 ABY]], the pirate was present on [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] when Rav offered [[Cade Skywalker]] a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on some natives on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. The pirate attacked Cade after he insulted the Nikto's family, but Cade easily [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pushed]] him off a waterfall.

==Personality and traits==
The Nikto pirate was arrogant in that he believed that he could take someone from the Skywalker line. He also was deeply offended when Cade insulted his family.

==Skills and abilities==
The Nikto was capable of using a [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] staff. He believed himself capable of fighting Cade Skywalker, who was immensely powerful in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. In the end, he was unable to hold his own against Skywalker.

==Behind the scenes==
The Zabrak first appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 43|forty-third issue]] of the [[2006]] [[Star Wars Legends|legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. The comic was written by [[John Ostrander]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[December 23]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-142/Star-Wars-Legacy-43----Vongspawn|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 43}}</ref>
